name: Holiday Crafts at Hayward Area Historical Society
address: 22380 Foothill Boulevard, Second Floor, Hayward, CA 94541
when_note: Third Saturday drop-in: storytime at 11:00 am, then drop in for crafts between 11:30 am and 2:30 pm.
paras: The Hayward Area Historical Society holds its Family Programs on the third Saturday of the month, and the December 19, 2026 session is Holiday Crafts. Storytime starts at 11:00 am, and kids can drop in for guided crafts from 11:30 am to 2:30 pm in the museum's classroom. No reservations are required, and the crafts are free.

The program takes place at the HAHS Museum of History & Culture on the second floor at 22380 Foothill Boulevard. Families can also see the local history and art exhibitions, try free-play art activities and explore the toy and book nook. Museum admission is a suggested $5 donation, and free parking is behind the building off Russell Way.
tip: Arrive for the 11:00 am storytime, then stay for the crafts and the toy and book nook, since the galleries close at 3 pm.

name: Midwinter Revels at Douglas Morrisson Theatre
when_note: Evening shows at 7:30 pm on Friday, December 11, Thursday, December 17 and Friday, December 18; matinees at 1:00 pm and evening shows at 6:00 pm on the weekends of December 12 to 13 and 19 to 20.
paras: California Revels presents The Midwinter Revels: American Crossroads at the Douglas Morrisson Theatre in Hayward from December 11 to 20, 2026. The Hayward Area Recreation and Park District describes it as a joyful celebration of American songs, dances and stories, and it marks 40 years of California Revels creating community through celebration.

This year's show is a journey through the USA in 1933 and the traditions that shaped a shared story. Audiences are invited to sing, clap and connect. Standard tickets are $35 for youth and $55 for adults, and VIP seats are $60 for youth and $80 for adults, with a mix of weekday evening shows and weekend matinees.
tip: Youth tickets cost less than adult tickets, so buy them in the same order and pick a weekend 1:00 pm matinee if bedtime is a worry.
